name: Dragon Gate Carps
description: The fish leaping over the dragon gate originates from the traditional Chinese mythology. The koi carps of the Yellow River swim upstream, leap in front of the dragon gate, transform into a dragon, and become worth a hundred times as much. It represents going against the current, working hard, career success and rising status, and expresses people's yearning for success. Pinku has made a jigsaw puzzle of the scene of the fish leaping over the dragon gate, wishing all the students to get on the gold medal list and reach high school in one fell swoop; to become professional elites and become famous. Let’s fight for a house treasure and look forward to good luck!
